questions.q: What did the cat see falling from the sky?
questions.explain: The cat saw fishes falling from the sky like a rain.

questions.q: Why did the cat want to eat so many fishes?
questions.explain: The cat thought if she eats enough fishes, she will grow up and become a tiger.

questions.q: What did the cat dream about?
questions.explain: The cat thought if she eats enough fishes, she will grow up and become a tiger.
